correctness.rationale: The one-sided vector fields were evaluated directly on both switching hypersurfaces. Their normal components coincide; the capacity interface is vector-field continuous; and the saltation, determinant, Floquet-product, and mosquito-fraction consequences follow algebraically under the stated transversality assumptions.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 preprint explicitly leaves Filippov sliding analysis of the two thresholds as future work. Searches of the source-specific and synonymous literature located no treatment of the no-sliding geometry or its unipotent saltation consequences for this model; standard generic Filippov and saltation theory is not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The result resolves an explicit open analytical direction for the model, distinguishes its two switching interfaces, and provides exact event matrices and determinant/infection-fraction invariants useful for Floquet analysis of the periodic outbreaks reported by the source.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
